name: Hunchback HBK-4G
notes: All coordinates are voxel cells in one shared model grid: x right, y up, -z front. Pivots are joint points in the same grid.
experimental_notes: Chassis-specific component resculpt based on existing source recipe and known visual anatomy; not photo-calibrated. Experimental only. Local structural support and short-gap repairs; not posed or photo calibrated.

experimental_photo_fit.method: Manually traced visible component bounds; independently optimized orthographic pose/camera; no pixel IoU claim.

notes: Raised asymmetric AC/20 hunch with actual bore; removed redundant right torso overlay; broader center chest.
experimental_reconstruction.limitations: Neutral low-resolution geometry audit, not Godot runtime or completed photographic multi-view match. P2 fit parameters are stale until P3 is refitted.

experimental_photo_fit_p3.method: Camera pose and articulation refitted separately to each annotated view; projected polygon overlap and occlusion-aware visible voxel region IoU. Approximate manual outlines, not camera metrology.

experimental_photo_fit_p4.method: Shared geometry refined across annotated reference views, independent camera and articulated stance; candidate shape edits accepted only after actual voxel repair, objective improvement and visible region overlap gate.

experimental_render_payload.encoding: LZW 12-bit codes, 64-symbol initial dictionary, clear=4095; alphabet A-Z a-z 0-9 - _
